name: El Paso Community Foundation Scholarships
deadline: ~March 1, 2027 (recurring annual window; exact 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: El Paso-area graduating high school seniors. Specific GPA, financial-need, and major requirements vary by the individual named fund inside the portal.
application_requirements: Single portal application covers dozens of named funds; essay and reference requirements vary by fund; FAFSA required for some need-based funds.
notes: Umbrella community foundation hosting many El Paso-area named funds. Check the portal each cycle for exact per-fund dates.

name: Paso del Norte Community Foundation Scholarships
deadline: Deadlines vary by fund; most historically close in spring (Mar-Apr)
eligibility: El Paso County graduating seniors. Individual named funds add GPA, service-hour, or campus-specific requirements.
application_requirements: Single portal application (Going Merry / Scholarship360); essay and 1-2 recommendation letters typical per fund.
notes: Hosts named funds including Tito's Way, the Richard Castro Community Service Scholarship, the Braden Aboud B STRONG UTEP Scholarship, and the EPISD Education Foundation fund.

name: SISD Foundation Scholarship
award_amount: $3,000-$3,500 district-wide award (split among winners), plus separate school-specific awards of $1,000-$2,500
deadline: AMBIGUOUS - site still showed the 2024-25 cycle as of last check; call to confirm the Class-of-2027 date
eligibility: Socorro ISD (SISD) seniors with two full years (11th-12th grade) at an SISD high school.
application_requirements: Application form via sisdfoundation.org; essay and transcript typically required.
notes: STALE DEADLINE FLAG: sponsor page had not been updated for the current cycle at last check. Call the SISD Foundation at (915) 937-1618 to confirm dates before relying on this.

name: El Paso ISD Education Foundation Scholarship
deadline: ~April 10, 2027 (2026 cycle closed April 10, 2026; 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: Graduating seniors from El Paso ISD (EPISD) schools only. Not open to students in other districts (Socorro ISD, Ysleta ISD, Canutillo ISD, etc.).
application_requirements: Original personal essay required (AI-generated content is explicitly disqualifying); selection weighs academics, leadership, and community service.
notes: District-restricted. Confirm the applicant's high school is inside El Paso ISD boundaries (not Socorro, Ysleta, or Canutillo ISD) before applying.

name: Braden Aboud B STRONG UTEP Scholarship
deadline: ~April 3, 2027 (2026 cycle deadline was April 3, 2026; confirm 2027 date)
eligibility: El Paso-area graduating seniors who are accepted to AND plan to attend the University of Texas at El Paso (UTEP).
application_requirements: Application via Scholarships360 portal; high school transcript; two letters of recommendation (one academic, one community-based).
notes: Requires a genuine intent to enroll at UTEP specifically, not just an admission offer used as a backup.

name: UTEP Terry Scholars Program
deadline: Early January 2027 (exact date not posted; historically closes the first week of January)
eligibility: FAFSA-demonstrated financial need, 3.0+ GPA, admitted to UTEP, and must live in scholar housing during the freshman year.
application_requirements: FAFSA required; separate Terry Scholars application submitted on top of standard UTEP admission.
notes: Combines need and merit; requires UTEP admission as a prerequisite.

name: GECU Robert A. Cunningham Memorial Scholarship
deadline: Reopens ~January 2027 (exact date not yet posted)
eligibility: Active GECU credit union membership (a deposit or loan account) required; B average; weighted toward community service.
application_requirements: Application via GECU's own site; essay on community service typical.
notes: Serves El Paso, West Texas, and southern New Mexico. GECU membership is a hard requirement, not just eligibility criteria.

name: Dell Scholars Program
award_amount: $20,000 plus a laptop and textbook credits
deadline: ~February 15, 2027 (estimated, based on the recurring annual window)
eligibility: Demonstrated significant financial need (Pell-eligible range) and evidence of overcoming substantial obstacles; minimum 2.4 GPA.
application_requirements: Online application; personal essay; values resilience and grit over test scores.

name: Horatio Alger National / Texas Scholarship
deadline: ~October 25, 2026 (estimated, based on the recurring cycle)
eligibility: Significant financial need (family income under a published threshold), demonstrated resilience through personal adversity, and involvement in co-curricular activities.
application_requirements: Online application; personal essay on adversity and perseverance; income documentation.
notes: Texas residents are automatically considered for both the National and Texas-specific awards on one application.

name: Jack Kent Cooke Foundation College Scholarship
award_amount: Up to $55,000/year, renewable for up to 4 years
deadline: ~November 13, 2026 (estimated)
eligibility: Top ~15% academic performance, financial need (household income typically under roughly $95,000), and a leadership/service record.
application_requirements: Extensive online application; multiple essays; transcript; two recommendation letters; financial documentation.
notes: One of the largest need-based awards available directly to a high school senior; highly competitive.

name: QuestBridge National College Match
award_amount: Full four-year scholarship (tuition, room, and board) at a partner college
deadline: October 1, 2026
eligibility: High-achieving students from low-income backgrounds (no hard income cutoff, but typically well under national median household income).
application_requirements: Online application; essays; transcript; two teacher recommendations; financial documents; no application fee.
notes: DEADLINE CORRECTION: many third-party trackers list Sept 26 for this deadline. QuestBridge's own dates-and-deadlines page confirms Oct 1, 2026 is correct.

name: Chick-fil-A Community Scholars
award_amount: Renewable need-based award (amount varies by cohort)
deadline: Opens ~August, closes ~October each cycle (exact 2026-27 close date not confirmed on the sponsor's own page at last check)
eligibility: 3.0+ GPA, documented financial need, and community involvement. The 2026-27 cycle explicitly covers students enrolling fall 2027.
application_requirements: Online application; essay on community impact.
notes: Large national applicant pool.

name: HACU / Denny's Hungry for Education Scholarship
award_amount: $1,000-$4,500 depending on partner track (HACU $2,000 x5; USHLI $1,000 x8; WBENC $4,500)
deadline: Partner windows vary; 2026 dates were Jan 7-Mar 1 (WBENC), Feb 1-May 15 (HACU), Feb 12-Apr 12 (USHLI). 2027 dates not yet posted.
eligibility: Minimum 2.5 GPA. No ethnicity, state, or major restriction stated.
application_requirements: 300-word essay (high school track) on how Denny's can bring communities together. FAFSA not mentioned as a requirement.
notes: AMBIGUOUS: unclear whether a graduating senior not yet enrolled anywhere can apply, or whether applicants must already be enrolled in K-12 or college. Confirm with HACU or Denny's directly.

name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program
deadline: September 30, 2026, 5:00pm ET
eligibility: Graduating high school seniors; US citizens, permanent residents, or DACA recipients. No published GPA cutoff, but highly competitive.
application_requirements: Phase 1: online application only, no essay/transcript/letters required. Later phases add essays and interviews.
notes: Closes very soon relative to a fall 2026 dataset build — confirm this cycle hasn't already closed before featuring it prominently.

name: Elks National Foundation Most Valuable Student Scholarship
deadline: ~November 15, 2026 (estimated)
eligibility: US citizen graduating senior. Based on scholastic achievement, leadership, and financial need combined. No Elks membership or family connection required.
application_requirements: Online application; transcript; leadership and activity record; essay.

name: National Honor Society Scholarship
award_amount: 600 awards from a $2 million pool (individual award amounts vary)
deadline: November 20, 2026
eligibility: Must be an active NHS member in good standing at the time of application.
application_requirements: Online application through NHS; transcript, activity record, and essay.
notes: Large national applicant pool. Confirm active NHS chapter membership status first.

name: Texas PTA High School Senior Scholarship
deadline: Window runs approximately September 15 - November 15, 2026
eligibility: Must be a PTA member at the applicant's own high school by December 1; Texas resident graduating senior.
application_requirements: Online application via Texas PTA; transcript; essay or activity summary.
notes: Requires active PTA membership at the applicant's specific campus. Confirm the school has a registered, active PTA chapter before applying.

name: GE-Reagan Foundation Scholarship
deadline: 2027 cycle dates not yet posted; use the sponsor's notify-me form
eligibility: Demonstrated leadership, integrity/character, citizenship, and drive to achieve. Open to graduating seniors broadly.
application_requirements: Online application; multiple short essays; transcript; two recommendations.
notes: Large, well-known national applicant pool.

name: Regions Riding Forward Scholarship Contest
deadline: Quarterly; next close ~September 30, 2026, then subsequent quarters through the year
eligibility: Resident of one of Regions Bank's 15-state footprint (Texas included); must plan to start college by fall 2027.
application_requirements: Short essay contest per the official rules PDF published by Regions Bank.
notes: Repeats every quarter, so it's worth entering more than once a year.

name: Hispanic Scholarship Fund (HSF) Scholarship
deadline: ~February 15, 2027 (estimated, recurring window)
eligibility: Hispanic heritage (self-identified); minimum 3.0 GPA; enrolling full-time at an accredited US institution; US citizen, permanent resident, DACA recipient, or eligible non-citizen.
application_requirements: FAFSA or state financial aid application required; online application; essay.
notes: One of the largest and most established Hispanic-serving scholarship programs in the country.

name: McDonald's HACER National Scholarship
award_amount: $1 million total pool shared across up to 100 students nationally
deadline: CLOSED as of last check (mcdonalds.com states the application period is currently closed); next cycle date not posted
eligibility: At least one parent of Hispanic heritage; demonstrated financial need; graduating high school senior. Full GPA/grade-level criteria are on the sponsor's separate eligibility page, not confirmed here.
application_requirements: Online application; personal statement; financial-need documentation.
notes: STALE/AMBIGUOUS: sponsor's own page shows the application period closed and does not display the next cycle's dates. Confirm reopening date directly before relying on this.

name: Jackie Robinson Foundation Scholarship
deadline: Early January (exact 2027 date not confirmed)
eligibility: No race restriction despite the namesake — explicitly race-neutral. Rewards leadership and community service; financial need considered.
application_requirements: CSS Profile required; online application; essays; recommendations.
notes: Included as demographic-adjacent because of its namesake and mission, but eligibility itself is race-neutral.

name: NAACP LDF Herbert Lehman Education Fund
deadline: ~April (2026 cycle already closed; 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: Explicitly race-neutral despite the NAACP LDF branding. Family income must be $70,000 or under.
application_requirements: Online application via the LDF portal; income documentation; essay.
notes: Most applicants assume this is race-restricted and skip it; it is not.

name: UNCF STEM Scholars Scholarship
award_amount: Amount not confirmed on the sponsor's own page; third-party trackers (Opportunity Desk, Scholarships360) report up to $25,000 for the 2026-27 cycle
deadline: AMBIGUOUS - uncf.org's own program page still displays an expired April 17, 2020 deadline; a 2026-27 cycle is reported open by secondary sources but not confirmed directly on the sponsor's site
eligibility: Must be African American; entering college as a first-time freshman; minimum 3.0 GPA; pursuing an approved STEM major; demonstrated financial need.
application_requirements: Online application; financial documentation; transcript.
notes: STALE DEADLINE FLAG per this dataset's sourcing rules: do not treat the $25,000/current-cycle claim as confirmed until it appears on uncf.org itself. Open to any accredited college, not just HBCUs.

name: APIA Scholars (APIASF) General Scholarship
deadline: 2026-27 cycle already closed. Next cycle (2027-28) opens fall 2026 with a stated deadline of January 15, 2027, 5:00pm EST.
eligibility: Must be of Asian and/or Pacific Islander ethnicity as defined by the US Census (citizens of the Marshall Islands, Federated States of Micronesia, and Palau are also eligible). Prioritizes applicants with significant financial need; first-generation students are prioritized but not required.
application_requirements: Online application; financial documentation; check the sponsor's FAQ and Application Guide for exact essay requirements.
notes: Ethnicity requirement confirmed directly against the sponsor's own eligibility criteria.

name: El Paso Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (EPHCC) Foundation Scholarship
deadline: ~April 1, 2027 (recurring annual window; exact 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: El Paso-area graduating seniors; strongest fit for students connected to Hispanic-owned business or entrepreneurship interests, though not exclusively restricted to Hispanic applicants on every track.
application_requirements: Application via ephcc.org; essay and transcript typical.
notes: Small local pool relative to national demographic funds.

name: El Paso Electric Scholarship
deadline: ~February 1, 2027 (recurring annual window; exact 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: El Paso-area graduating seniors; STEM-leaning local corporate award.
application_requirements: No official standalone application URL was found; historically distributed through school counselors or the El Paso Community Foundation portal.
notes: NO CONFIRMED STANDALONE SOURCE: could not find a dedicated application page directly from El Paso Electric. Check with a school counselor or the El Paso Community Foundation before assuming this is currently active.

name: FirstLight Community Foundation Graduating Seniors Scholarship
deadline: Cycle historically opens January; exact 2027 date not yet posted
eligibility: Any graduate of an El Paso, Fort Bliss, or Doña Ana County (NM) high school; minimum 2.5 GPA. This is the PUBLIC award, distinct from FirstLight's credit-union-employee-dependent scholarship.
application_requirements: Online application via the foundation's own site; essay typical.
notes: Do not confuse with FirstLight Federal Credit Union's separate employee-dependent scholarship, which has a hard eligibility gate this one does not.

name: MountainStar All-Star Scholarship (El Paso Chihuahuas)
deadline: 2026 cycle closed April 30, 2026; expect a February 2027 reopen
eligibility: Juniors and seniors at any high school across El Paso and Las Cruces, NM.
application_requirements: Online application via MiLB/El Paso Chihuahuas site; essay and activity record.
notes: Spans two metro areas (El Paso and Las Cruces), so the applicant pool is somewhat larger than a single-city award.

name: EPCC Foundation Scholarship
deadline: Portal runs January 1 to March 31 each year
eligibility: Open to high school seniors regardless of intended major or residency, as long as they are attending (or dual-enrolled at) El Paso Community College.
application_requirements: Online portal application; specific named funds within it may add essay or transcript requirements.
notes: Call the EPCC Financial Aid office (915-831-3722) for the list of named funds within the portal.

name: Makios Technology Fund
deadline: ~December 31, 2026 (estimated, based on the recurring cycle)
eligibility: El Paso County residents pursuing an IT or technology career path.
application_requirements: Applies via the El Paso Community Foundation portal.
notes: Narrow geographic and major restriction keeps the applicant pool small — a strong bet for a CS/IT-track student.

name: GECU Financial Literacy Scholarship
deadline: Typically April-May (exact 2027 date not yet posted)
eligibility: Open to non-members across Texas and New Mexico — no GECU account required, unlike GECU's Cunningham award.
application_requirements: Must complete GECU's online financial-literacy learning modules before the accompanying essay counts.
notes: No membership required, which is the key difference from most other GECU/credit-union awards.

name: Sallie Mae Bridging the Dream Scholarship
deadline: Cycle closes around late April; watch for the spring 2027 round
eligibility: Pell Grant-eligible graduating high school seniors.
application_requirements: Online application; FAFSA-linked Pell eligibility confirmation.
notes: Runs annually; not discontinued despite what some aggregators imply.

name: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship
deadline: 2026-27 cycle not yet open at last check
eligibility: Demonstrated financial need; minimum 2.3 GPA; must have taken CS coursework; no race or gender restriction; requires US work authorization.
application_requirements: Online application; CS coursework record; financial documentation.
notes: Strong fit for a CS-track student with financial need.

name: Terry Foundation Scholarship — UT Austin track
deadline: ~January 15, 2027 (flows through UT Austin's general scholarship form)
eligibility: Admitted or admissible to UT Austin; combines demonstrated financial need with academic merit; a supplemental leadership essay is required.
application_requirements: Flows through UT Austin's general scholarship application; supplemental essay.
notes: The Terry Foundation also funds tracks at several other Texas public universities (A&M, UT Dallas, etc.) under separate applications.

name: Greater Texas Foundation Scholarship
deadline: ~February 15, 2027 (estimated)
eligibility: Texas resident students with demonstrated financial need.
application_requirements: Online application; FAFSA/TASFA-linked need documentation.

name: UT System Promise+ (Tuition & Fee Waiver)
award_amount: Full tuition and mandatory fees waived
deadline: No application deadline of its own — triggers automatically off FAFSA/TASFA
eligibility: Texas resident, full-time enrollment at any of the 9 UT System academic campuses (UTEP, UT Austin, UT Dallas, etc.), family AGI at or under roughly $100,000.
application_requirements: Not a separate application — automatically applied once FAFSA or TASFA is filed and the student is admitted and enrolled full-time. Covers tuition and mandatory fees ONLY; housing, meals, and books are not included.
notes: Not a scholarship to 'apply' for in the traditional sense, but the single biggest need-based lever available to a Texas resident attending any UT System school, including UTEP.

name: NACME Common Application
award_amount: Feeds a matching pool of awards up to $5,000
deadline: Rolling, no fixed deadline
eligibility: Open to students planning to major in engineering or computer science; historically serves Black, Hispanic, and Native American students, though current NACME pages no longer state this explicitly.
application_requirements: One common online application that lets NACME match applicants to member-funded awards.
notes: Submitting it guarantees nothing on its own — most NACME-named awards require admission to or enrollment at a NACME Partner Institution first.

name: Foot Locker Scholar Athletes Scholarship
deadline: ~December 12, 2026 (estimated)
eligibility: Graduating senior who is a varsity athlete with strong academics and community service involvement.
application_requirements: Online application; academic transcript; athletic and community-service record; essay.
notes: Rewards the combination of athletics, academics, and service rather than athletics alone.

name: VFW Voice of Democracy Scholarship
award_amount: Up to $35,000 (national first place; smaller awards at post/district/state level)
deadline: ~October 31, 2026
eligibility: Grades 9-12; open contest — no VFW family connection or membership required.
application_requirements: Audio-essay contest on an annual patriotic theme; submitted through a local sponsoring VFW Post.
notes: Requires finding and entering through a local VFW Post — El Paso has several.

name: American Legion Texas Oratorical Contest
award_amount: $500-$2,000 at the state level; up to $25,000 at the national level
deadline: Local rounds run Nov 7-Dec 5; district by Jan 9; state finals Feb 15 (2026-27 cycle)
eligibility: Open contest; no American Legion family connection required.
application_requirements: Constitution-themed speech contest; must be entered through a sponsoring local Post.
notes: Multi-round format (local, district, state) means real time investment but a genuinely small pool at each round.

name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
deadline: ~February 11, 2027 (estimated)
eligibility: Students 18 or younger who have completed a significant, original piece of work (research, technology, literature, music, etc.).
application_requirements: A substantial project portfolio is required — this is not a general essay contest.
notes: High bar to enter (requires an existing significant project) but a correspondingly small, elite applicant pool.

name: Ayn Rand Institute Atlas Shrugged Essay Contest
deadline: ~November 6, 2026 (estimated)
eligibility: High school seniors (grade-specific contests also exist for other Ayn Rand novels).
application_requirements: Pure essay contest — no recommenders or transcript required.
notes: Low application overhead relative to the award size.

name: Optimist International Essay Contest
deadline: ~December 31, 2026 (estimated)
eligibility: Open to students under 19; entered through a local sponsoring Optimist Club.
application_requirements: Short essay on an annual theme, judged first at the local club level.
notes: Runs through the local El Paso Optimist Club — contact them directly to be entered.

name: TheDream.US National Scholarship
award_amount: Up to $33,000 toward tuition/fees for a bachelor's degree, plus up to $6,000 in additional stipends for books, supplies, and transportation
deadline: 2026-27 cycle is currently closed (ran Nov 1, 2025-Feb 28, 2026); the 2027-28 round is expected to open November 1, 2026
eligibility: First-generation immigrant students who are undocumented, DACA, or TPS status; arrived in the US before age 16 and before Nov 1, 2020; minimum 2.5 GPA; must have unmet financial need AND NOT be eligible for a federal Pell Grant; must attend a Partner College.
application_requirements: Online application; GPA and income documentation; must enroll full-time at a Partner College.
notes: UTEP IS a confirmed TheDream.US Partner College (thedream.us/partner_college/university-of-texas-el-paso/), so this is genuinely usable for an El Paso-area student attending UTEP — an initial page summary incorrectly suggested Texas schools were excluded; that was checked and corrected against the sponsor's own partner-college listing.

name: Point Foundation Flagship Scholarship
deadline: 2026-27 cycle: opened Sept 9, closes November 19, 5:00pm PST
eligibility: Member of the LGBTQ+ community or an ally; minimum 3.3 GPA; must be at least a high school senior at time of application; full-time enrollment in a nonprofit, non-online degree program starting fall 2027.
application_requirements: Online application portal; the sponsor's site does not detail exact essay/recommendation requirements beyond the portal itself.
notes: Open to allies as well as LGBTQ+ students, which widens eligibility beyond what the name implies.

name: AISES Indigenous Peoples Education Fund Scholarship
deadline: April 30 (recurring annual date)
eligibility: Incoming freshman enrolled full-time; enrolled member or descendant of a federally-recognized American Indian tribe, Native Hawaiian, Pacific Islander, or Indigenous person of Canada; free AISES student membership required; minimum 3.0 GPA; any STEM major.
application_requirements: Transcript; two letters of recommendation; documentation verifying tribal citizenship or descendancy (enrollment card, birth certificate, or CDIB card).
notes: Most other AISES-listed scholarships require the applicant to already be enrolled in college — this is the one clearly open to an incoming freshman.

name: SWE (Society of Women Engineers) Emerging First Year Scholars
award_amount: Individual award amounts vary; over $1.6 million distributed across 330+ awards in a recent cycle
deadline: 2026-27 cycle already closed (Feb-Mar window); 2027-28 cycle expected to open February 2027
eligibility: Identifies as a woman (per SWE's program mission and guidelines); minimum 3.5 GPA; intending to enroll in an ABET-accredited engineering, engineering technology, or computer science program.
application_requirements: Online application through SWE's portal; exact essay/recommendation requirements not fully detailed on the overview page — confirm via SWE's FAQ.
notes: The sponsor's overview page did not spell out the gender-eligibility wording verbatim; confirm exact eligibility language directly on SWE's site before applying.

name: Anne Ford & Allegra Ford Thomas Scholarship
deadline: Rolling review until May 10, 2026 for the current cycle; watch for the 2027 cycle to open similarly
eligibility: Graduating high school senior with a documented learning disability (dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia, dyspraxia, or another specific learning disability; students with ADHD plus a qualifying learning disability may also apply).
application_requirements: Multi-step online form; FAFSA/EFC documentation; at least one recommendation letter; responses to three personal questions (text, video, or audio); proof-of-diagnosis documentation.
notes: No GPA cutoff — selection is explicitly about the applicant's personal narrative and leadership potential, not grades.

name: Hispanic Scholarship Consortium (Common Application)
deadline: Not published on the sponsor's own site; a commonly-cited Aug 31 date is actually when past winners were NOTIFIED, not an application close date — call to confirm
eligibility: Texas residency; minimum 2.5 GPA; high school graduate or graduating senior.
application_requirements: One common application read by 130+ member Texas Hispanic-serving organizations and foundations.
notes: AMBIGUOUS DEADLINE per this dataset's sourcing rules: call 512-368-2956 to confirm the real application window before treating any specific date as final. Functions as a hub, not a single award — one application reaches many funders at once.
